Anil Kumar --Appellant
 
Versus
State of Uttarakhand --Respondent
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J. 
Mr. Kishore Rai, learned counsel for the 
appellant.
2. Mr. Tumul K Nainwal, learned AGA,
for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. The instant criminal appeal has been 
preferred by the appellant – Anil Kumar S/o 
Shri Ramesh Ram (convict) against the 
judgment and order passed by the learned
Special Judge (NDPS Act) District Udham 
Singh Nagar, dated 22/25.08.2026 in Sessions
Trial No.460 of 2021, “State of Uttarakhand
Vs. Harish and another”, whereby the 
appellant has been convicted for the offences 
punishable under Sections 20(b)(ii)(B) of the 
NDPS Act, with the sentence of ten years of 
rigorous imprisonment and fine of 
Rs.1,00,000/-. 
4. It is apprised that the appeal preferred 
by the co-accused – Harish,, is already 
admitted on 11.09.2026 and the trial court 
record is also summoned and the State was 
directed to file objections to the bail 
application, and the matter is fixed on 
08.10.2026.
5. Since this is an appeal by another co￾accused against conviction, hence it has to be  admitted.
6. Admit.
7. List this appeal on 08.10.2026 along with 
CRLA No.521 of 2026.
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 23.09.2026
Nitesh/
